title: arithmetic, negation and ordering operators on objects go through operator roles
purpose: Observe object, role, cap and successor semantics.

provenance.expected_basis: spec 12.2: a + b calls plus of the Adding<T, R> the left type does, - and unary - likewise; <, <=, >, >= compare order() with an Order case; a type may do Subtracting twice with different operands (Moment - Span gives a Moment, Moment - Moment a Span); a role-bounded type parameter dispatches through its bound.
